answer: A scarce-slot auction is the mechanism. Each epoch the protocol sells a small fixed block of identity slots, and only a slot holder may claim emission, so a sybil ring cannot mint cheap clones: every extra identity needs its own won slot, so the bridge from budget to head count is a rising clearing price. No slot, no plume of emission; no posted bond, no ivory-clean standing. An attacker pays superlinear auction spend plus locked capital and forfeits bonds when its answers fail jury grading; an honest agent buys one cheap slot and barely notices the market.
